mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_action_logs ( participant_id, session_id, scenario_id, game_tick, action_type, asset_type, action_amount, market_state, deposit_status, current_cash, current_stock, current_deposit, rt_score_delta, lh_score_delta, rp_score_delta ) VALUES ( #{participantId}, #{sessionId}, #{scenarioId}, #{gameTick}, #{actionType}, #{assetType}, #{actionAmount}, #{marketState}, #{depositStatus}, #{currentCash}, #{currentStock}, #{currentDeposit}, #{rtScoreDelta}, #{lhScoreDelta}, #{rpScoreDelta} )
mapper.select: SELECT action_log_id AS actionLogId, participant_id AS participantId, session_id AS sessionId, scenario_id AS scenarioId, game_tick AS gameTick, action_type AS actionType, asset_type AS assetType, action_amount AS actionAmount, market_state AS marketState, deposit_status AS depositStatus, current_cash AS currentCash, current_stock AS currentStock, current_deposit AS currentDeposit, rt_score_delta AS rtScoreDelta, lh_score_delta AS lhScoreDelta, rp_score_delta AS rpScoreDelta, created_at AS createdAt FROM event_action_logs WHERE participant_id = #{participantId} ORDER BY game_tick, action_log_id
